title: THE QUIET SCHOOL OF HIGH WENDEL
author: CLAUDE

rounds.summary: The quietest candidate makes the strongest closing contrast and the clearest R14 demonstration that understanding changes intervention. The children are not symbols of silence and Ines is not a straw engineer: a cable car ended winter isolation, while a channel nobody measured may be corrupting children's speech. Illuminara succeeds only by becoming a fallible student, letting a six-year-old correct her tone, and helping sceptics run a test they can inspect. The positive result preserves both the town's link and its language, while the children retain the choice and timing of speech and two may remain quiet for months.

First draft of S3 from C02, following B01 and S2 close. B01 risk handled: the acoustic claim is made reproducible and falsifiable before anyone hears a word. A card signed by Illuminara, Ines and Dr Orsolya fixes the pass criterion in advance (drive running: more than 3 of 12 children's recordings misheard, drive stopped: at most 1, adults correct both times). The same recordings are played with the drive running and stopped, with adult controls, in randomised order, to a panel of eight who write slips. Ines runs her own sweep on her own instrument and keeps authority over tension, brake and rope; she limits her change to isolation mount, casing absorber and a four percent speed reduction (about a minute and a half on a 38 minute ride), and a valley inspector verifies the result independently. Dr Orsolya is not humiliated: he names what would change his mind, withdraws only the transfer, keeps fear open as a live hypothesis and takes the two children (Wilma, Teo) who are still quiet. No child is asked to speak as proof; Nessa's one recording is played with her own permission. The discovery that changes the intervention (R14): Illuminara first turns her hearing down to a teacher's range and is herself misheard by the channel, then is corrected by a six-year-old (yes is a little hill, not a mountain); she is a bad student before she is a diagnostician. Love in action: a whole school day spent asking the children for nothing; consent asked before every recording; Ines's pride respected by letting her measure with her own instrument; the board's dissent kept. Outcome (3a): 38 of 40 speaking within three weeks, transfer shelved, the cable car kept with a measured change, two children still supported by the clinician. A warm, unusually coherent first draft that fulfils the selected premise without turning the engineer, physician or children into symbols. Illuminara becomes a fallible listener before she becomes a diagnostician; Nessa's little-hill correction changes the intervention; Ines demands an inspectable test; Orsolya preserves fear as a live alternative; and the ending gives speech, continued silence and clinical care equal dignity. Three causal joints need revision before final: Orsolya's present transfer recommendation is too coercive and under-worked to preserve his legitimate duty, the pre-signed experiment does not define how eight listeners turn slips into a pass or protect against a visible fixed-order condition, and the overnight gearbox intervention is acoustically verified without an equally explicit safety commissioning check. {"rank":1,"point_id":"P1","area":"make Orsolya's clinical concern and the clinic pathway legitimate, specific and voluntary","evidence":"At the gate Sabrina says the children still talk at home, especially in back rooms, yet Orsolya moves directly from the shared silence to a board vote that would send forty children away for six weeks with family visits only on Sundays. The draft shows no hearing, neurological, speech-language or trauma assessment already performed, and his line that a silent child has 'lost a year of language' is too broad for children who retain home speech. The later sentence that a family may request the clinic in three weeks restores consent only after the test has proved him wrong.","protect":"Keep Orsolya's promise to read a forty-first fact, his refusal to treat the acoustic result as proof that fear is absent, his public withdrawal of the transfer recommendation and his quiet care for Wilma and Teo.","problem":"Th

S3 T03 revision. Addressed P1, P2 and P3 of the T02 critique and the shape note. Protected: Illuminara turning her hearing down and being mis-heard; Nessa's little hill and her authority; the ambient-tone mechanism and 'a peak is not a child'; the criterion signed before listening, matched adult controls, consent, Illuminara not voting; Ines keeping the machine, refusing tension, brake and rope and naming the four percent; Orsolya keeping fear alive and taking Wilma and Teo; the non-unanimous board and the final snow scene. Changes: scene 1 gives Orsolya what he has ruled out, the concrete harm (reading assessments), consent and assent, and his opposition to the board's wording; scene 4 defines the panel design and the item rule on the card, adds the reversed order and one sceptical exchange; scene 5 names Ines's stop conditions and adds a one-paragraph commissioning ending on Sabrina's bread; scene 6 keeps Dessau visible as an offer that one family looked at and declined. Scenes 2 and 3 are unchanged. Outcome (3a) unchanged: 38 of 40 speaking, transfer shelved, the cable car kept with a measured change and a safety check, two children cared for with a second cause. Costs: a minute and a half on the ride, two quiet children, two board members who think the doctor yielded too fast. R14 evidence on the page: the carrying scenes are the garden (a six-year-old corrects Illuminara) and the noon test (criterion signed before the result), and now the gate, where Orsolya's duty is stated before it is answered. To check: whether scene 4 now reads as a methods section, whether Orsolya's three long turns in scene 1 stall the gate, and whether scene 3 is still too expository (unchanged). Speaking roles: five (Illuminara, Sabrina, Dr Orsolya, Nessa, Ines).

The revision substantially succeeds. Orsolya now has a defensible clinical duty, opposes compulsory board wording before Illuminara proves the acoustic mechanism, and retains a voluntary specialist option afterward. The listening test now has an item rule and opposed orders, and Ines's repair is followed by independent commissioning rather than an acoustic result alone. The emotional and causal spine remains intact: Illuminara becomes a student of Nessa, evidence changes two responsible adults without humiliating them, and the ending protects both the thirty-eight children who speak and the two who do not. Two localized clarifications remain for the final: state the complementary recording assignment that makes four judgments per condition reconstructible, and reconcile a four-hour shutdown with tests described from six to nine the next morning. {"rank":1,"point_id":"P1","area":"make the complementary recording assignment explicit so the revised listening test is fully reconstructible","evidence":"The signed card now says each of eight listeners hears all twenty-four voices once, half with the drive running and half stopped, and that every voice is heard by four listeners in each condition. The scene later has one group start with the running block, the other start with the stopped block and both change condition around the noon rest. But neither the card nor narration states that the two four-person panels receive complementary twelve-recording sets. Without that assignment, the arithmetic can also be read as each voice being heard eight times in a condition or as some voices appearing in only one condition. S3 T05 AUTHOR_FINAL. Only P1 and P2 of the T04 critique were changed; all other prose is identical to T03 (scenes 1-3 and 6 untouched). Scene 4: the card now states Set A/Set B allocation and the two panels' complementary order, the 'twenty minutes' rest has both rooms listening at once, and the order answer refers to panels. Scene 5: an overnight hold (last evening run until nine) named as an eleven-hour cost; times six to nine are the next morning. Shape line says 'a night of repair'. Outcome (3a) unchanged: transfer shelved, Dessau voluntary, car kept with measured acoustic gain and safety commissioning, thirty-eight children speaking, Wilma and Teo cared for. R14: understanding changes action (Illuminara lowers her hearing, accepts a six-year-old's correction, shares falsification authority); love is attention, consent, an inspectable test, a bounded repair and continuing care; no power decides the conflict.

The exact T05 final resolves both bounded points left by T04 without reopening the story's frame. The signed card now divides the twenty-four recordings into complementary A and B sets and assigns them to two four-person panels in opposed condition order, so every voice receives exactly four running-condition and four stopped-condition judgments while no listener hears a voice twice. The hall scene executes that assignment, preserves the three-of-four item rule and shows the same split in each panel. The repair is now an honestly priced overnight hold: the last evening run to nine in the morning, with sweeps at six, an empty run at seven, an emergency stop at eight and independently signed commissioning before the first loaded cabin at nine. These repairs preserve Nessa teaching Illuminara the small rising hill, Ines's intelligent resistance and engineering limits, Orsolya's duty and revision, the voluntary Dessau option, the thirty-eight children who resume speaking, and continuing care for Wilma and Teo. No further creative turn is justified.

final_critic_line: Illuminara learns from Nessa that the children are speaking clearly outside the school, then helps Ines and Dr Orsolya test the cable car's masking note under a signed, reconstructible protocol; Ines freely repairs the mechanism under independent safety commissioning, the board shelves compulsory transfer, thirty-eight children speak again, and the two whose silence has another root receive patient local care and a voluntary specialist option without being called failures.
